What happens when you run ki

Every AI agent starts from zero: it does not know our conventions, past decisions or what is running. kio fixes that. Everything I write, repos, notes, reviews, decisions and incidents, is turned into knowledge graphs, one per project, called brains. When I start an agent with ki, it works out which project and identity I am in; before planning, the agent asks ki-mcp for a context pack with that project's conventions, decisions and current state, trimmed to a budget. Each machine's token limits which brains it may read, everything runs on my own cluster behind my VPN, and a new note from any device is ingested within about ten minutes.
